query:
UPDATE refresh_token_families f
                SET revoked_at = now()
                FROM refresh_tokens t
                WHERE t.id = $1
                AND t.secret_digest = ANY($2)
                AND t.family_id = f.id
                AND f.client_id = $3
                AND f.revoked_at IS NULL
                RETURNING f.id AS "id: TokenId", f.user_id AS "user_id: UserId"
